prior_art: PRIOR ART: scripts/eval/lib/revision-source.mjs — names which MECHANISM wrote a `source` label so page_revisions can be segmented, but carries no generation settings and no dates; scripts/lib/write-provenance.mjs MODEL_DEFAULTS — the published model defaults this table refers to. Neither says what settings a page written in a given month ran under, which is what this table does.
purpose: What we can INFER, from git and from the fields old rows carry, about the generation settings behind pages written BEFORE the #4613 writers went live (Hetzner pull 2026-09-28T16:21Z). Every entry is an inference from code constants dated by `git log -S`, never an observation: nothing in these rows was recorded at write time. Read through inferHistoricalGeneration() in scripts/lib/write-provenance.mjs; never copy a value from here onto a page as if it were observed.
model_defaults_note: A setting a writer did not send ran at the model's published default (GET /v1beta/models/<id>, looked up 2026-09-28): temperature 1, topP 0.95, topK 64, outputTokenLimit 65536, thinking on (dynamic). MODEL_DEFAULTS in write-provenance.mjs is the table.
